transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. I'm Dr. [Name]. Can you tell me what brings you in today?

I’m… I’m sorry, I’m a little nervous. I guess what finally made me make the appointment is that I’ve been having thoughts that scare me. Not that I’m trying to be dramatic, but sometimes I think it would just be easier if I didn’t wake up.

And a couple times driving home from the clinic, I’ve caught myself wondering what would happen if I just… didn’t turn the wheel. I don’t like saying that out loud. I know that probably sounds bad.
Can you tell me if you've been feeling down or hopeless most days, and how long that's been going on?

Yeah… most days, I think. I try to tell myself it’s just stress or that I’m tired, and I don’t want to make it sound worse than it is, but… it’s like the color has drained out of everything.

Even when the house is busy and things are happening around me, I feel really hopeless. I’ll go hide in the laundry room and cry because I don’t want anyone to see me like that. I’m sorry, I don’t know if that’s the kind of answer you mean.
Have you ever felt this way before, where you've had times when you felt down, hopeless, or lost interest in things for a period of time?

Yes… I mean, I think so. It’s not like I can point to one exact day, but this has kind of been hanging over me for… maybe about 11 months now.

I kept telling myself it was manageable, or that it was just a rough stretch, and I probably should’ve come in sooner. This past month is when it started feeling really unbearable, but it was there before that too. Is that the kind of timeframe you mean?
Have you had more than one period of time when you felt this way, or has this been the only time you've experienced these feelings over the past year?

I think… it’s mostly been this same stretch, if that makes sense. It’s been kind of hanging over me for about 11 months now.

I don’t want to overstate it, because some days I can still function and get through what I need to do, but it hasn’t really gone away. This past month is when it started feeling unbearable, but it was there before that too. Does that answer what you’re asking?
Before this current period of feeling down and hopeless, have you ever had a time in your life when you felt this way for at least two weeks?

I’m… not really sure. I mean, I’ve had hard times before, of course, but I don’t know if I’d say it was like this for two full weeks or more.

I don’t want to give you the wrong answer. Nothing is coming to mind clearly the way this current stretch does. Does that make sense?
Before this current 11-month period, did you ever have a time when you felt down or hopeless nearly every day for at least two weeks in a row?

I don’t think so… not that I can clearly remember. I’ve definitely had rough patches before, but nearly every day for two weeks straight, before this? I’m not sure I can honestly say that.

I don’t want to answer wrong or make it sound like it never happened if I’m just not remembering, but nothing really stands out to me the way this current period does.
Before this current period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or hopeless nearly every day for two weeks or more?

I don’t think I can point to a time before this that was that steady, no… at least not clearly.

What I can say is that with this period, most days it’s like the color has just drained out of everything. Even when the house is busy around me, I’ll go cry in the laundry room because I can’t stand anyone seeing how hopeless I feel. I’m sorry if that’s not exactly answering the “before” part.

Before this current 11-month period, have you ever had a time when you felt down or hopeless nearly every day for at least two weeks, and then had a period of at least two months where you felt much better or were back to your usual self?

I’m not sure I can say yes to that. Before these last 11 months, I don’t really remember a clear stretch like that—two weeks or more of feeling down nearly every day—and then a definite two months where I bounced back.

I mean, I’ve had normal ups and downs, but nothing that’s clear enough for me to feel confident saying that happened. Does that answer it okay?
Have you ever had at least two different times in your life when you felt down or hopeless nearly every day for two weeks or more?

I’m not sure I can say there have been two different times like that. The one that really stands out is this current one.

Most days now, it’s like everything has gone kind of gray, like the color’s drained out of it. Even when the house is busy, I’ll sometimes go cry in the laundry room because I don’t want anyone to see how hopeless I feel.

But before this… I don’t know that I can honestly identify another separate time that was nearly every day for two weeks or more. Does that make sense?
Have you ever had a time when you felt much better or back to your usual self for at least two months between any past periods of feeling down or hopeless?

I don’t think so… or at least I can’t identify that kind of pattern clearly.

Since I’m not even sure there were separate past periods like that, I can’t really say there was a two-month stretch in between where I was back to myself. I’m sorry—I know that’s probably not as clear as you’re looking for.

Before this current 11-month period, have you ever had a time when you experienced a major drop in mood that met the level of needing treatment or significantly affected your daily life, even if only for a short time?

Before this current stretch… I don’t think so. Not in a way that I’d say really affected my daily life or rose to the level of needing treatment.

I mean, I’ve had hard days, like anyone, and stressful periods, but I can’t point to a specific earlier time where my mood dropped that severely. I don’t want to overstate it just to give an answer—does that make sense?

Have you ever had at least two separate times when your mood dropped significantly, each lasting at least two weeks, and with a clear period of feeling back to normal or much better in between them for at least two months?

No… I don’t think I can say that. I’m trying to be accurate and not just guess.

I really only know about this current period clearly. I can’t identify two separate times like that, with both lasting at least two weeks and then a clear two months of feeling normal in between. If it happened, I don’t remember it that way. Does that answer what you’re asking?
Before this current period of feeling down and hopeless, have you ever had a major drop in mood that lasted at least two weeks, then improved for at least two months before coming back?

I don’t think so, no. I’m sorry, I know you’re trying to pin down the timing, but I can’t honestly remember a clear episode before this one that lasted two weeks, then got better for a couple months, and then came back.

There may have been normal ups and downs, but not something I’d feel comfortable calling that. Does that make sense?
During this current 11-month period, has there ever been a time when you felt much better or back to your usual self for at least two months?

No… I don’t think I’ve had a stretch like that. I wish I could say there was a couple months where I felt like myself again, but it’s kind of been hanging over me for about 11 months.

There might have been better days here and there, but not really two months of being back to normal. And this past month has made it feel… unbearable, honestly. Does that sound like what you mean?

Before this current 11-month period, have you ever had a time when your mood dropped significantly and you felt down or hopeless nearly every day for at least two weeks, followed by a clear period of at least two months where you felt much better or back to your usual self?

I don’t think I can clearly say yes to that. I mean, before this last 11 months, I’m sure I had times where I felt low or stressed, but I can’t point to a specific period where I was down nearly every day for two weeks and then definitely back to myself for two months.

I don’t want to overstate it or give you the wrong impression. So… I’d say no, or at least not that I can remember clearly. Is that okay?
Before this current 11-month period, have you ever had a time when your mood dropped significantly and you felt down or hopeless nearly every day for at least two weeks, even if it didn’t last long?

I’m not sure I can point to one before this, honestly. I don’t want to make it sound worse than it was if I’m remembering it wrong.

What I can say is… lately, most days it feels like the color has just drained out of everything, even when the house is busy around me. I try to keep it together, but sometimes I end up crying in the laundry room because I don’t want anyone to see how hopeless I feel.

But before these 11 months, I don’t know that I can clearly say there was a two-week stretch like that. Is that the kind of thing you’re asking?
